title: MZ Speculating: How best to replicate Mystery Dungeon and Fallout/Arcanum in RPG Maker MZ ?

posts.author: Dollar_Store_Diogenes
posts.body:
I should like to begin this post by admitting that I have, personally, never in my life played a Mystery Dungeon game *ever* for more then like, 15 minutes when I was a school boy, once. Now, you might be thinking to yourself, "Well that's a bit silly, innit? How can you replicate the feel of a game/genre that you've never truly experienced before?" Well, I attribute the idea to having popped into my head the other day while watching an Avalanche Reviews vid on a new indie game whose sticking point was that it was basically a Mystery Dungeon game set within the framing of an RE1 Pastiche. Avalanche starts off the video by giving basically a short introductory rundown on both the history and gameplay mechanics of the archetypal Mystery Dungeon game.
What caught my attention while he was doing the rundown was the idea of the mechanics behind a Mystery Dungeon game's movement system; The concept of the game still being, "turn-based," but in such a way where both the player and enemy actors take their, "turns," at the same time by tying these two opposing forces together by having it be that enemies move or act whenever the player moves or acts, usually all within the limits of a stamina bar of some kind. This stood out to me personally as someone who absolutely
loved
playing through the Fallout 1, 2 and Arcanum because in those games (but especially Arcanum) combat is played through a turn-based system on the overworld where the player's chances to act is directly affected by their action points/stamina (Doubly so in Arcanum if the player toggles on, "real-time" mode.)
After playing around a bit with MythAtelier's Turn-based movement plugin in combination with Sang Hendrix's Action Combat plugin and Project Ace's SRPG Gear plugin (as well as looking into Synrec's Tactical Battle plugin) I am now convinced that it is possible to replicate the classical western CRPG style of gameplay within the confines of MZ's engine by reinventing it from first principles by using Mystery Dungeon as a blueprint!
My line of thinking is: Using something like SRPG Gear's attack square range and brief Sideview battle transitions (both very reminiscent of old-school fire emblem,) and combining them with something like MythAtelier's Mystery Dungeon-esque movement plugin, while tweaking the MD-style movement plugin so that enemies move when you act as well as when you move, a dev would be able to achieve a, "turn-based," style of gameplay where players act mainly on the overworld map within the limitations set by their action points/stamina, which sounds a lot like Arcanum's specific brand of CRPG gameplay to me!
I would like to try doing something like this, but I'm still fairly new to coding for RPG Maker MZ and, by extension, Java Script as a whole. The most coding I've ever done before was in Papyrus for the Skyrim CK and brother, you better
believe
that I hated every second of it, lol. So what do you guys think? How could I go about making this sorta thing a real, tangible plugin? Or else, what tips would you give me on how to learn enough Java Script to be able to realize it?
